items.headline: 第81届联合国大会今天开幕
items.headline_en: The 81st UN General Assembly opens today
items.summary: 第81届联合国大会将于纽约时间9月8日15时开幕，由孟加拉国外交官拉赫曼主持。联合国193个会员国在大会均有一票。
items.summary_en: The 81st session opens in New York at 3 p.m. on 8 September, chaired by Bangladesh's Khalilur Rahman. Each of the UN's 193 member states has one vote.

items.headline: 中国为传统产业设下2028年目标
items.headline_en: China sets 2028 targets for traditional industries
items.summary: 六部门首次为丝绸、茶、陶瓷等传统产业发布全国性政策，提出到2028年培育50家年营收超100亿元的企业，并用AI记录工艺、改进生产。
items.summary_en: China issued its first national policy for silk, tea and porcelain. It targets 50 firms with annual revenue above 10 billion yuan by 2028 and wider use of AI in craft records and production.

source.name: 中国政府网 / 新华社

items.headline: 新工具从三维脑成像中提取神经元
items.headline_en: New tool extracts neurons from 3D brain imaging
items.summary: DeepWonder3D可从多视角三维钙成像中定位神经元。论文称，它把计算成本降至约十分之一，并能在数小时内处理小鼠皮层数万个神经元。
items.summary_en: DeepWonder3D extracts neurons from multiview calcium imaging. The paper reports one tenth of the computing cost of leading methods and processes tens of thousands of neurons within hours.

items.headline: 极端山火烟霾事件较上世纪90年代增至三倍
items.headline_en: Extreme wildfire smoke events have tripled since the 1990s
items.summary: 世界气象组织新公报援引研究称，全球极端山火烟霾事件已增至上世纪90年代的三倍，2010至2018年间每年或额外造成近10万人死亡。
items.summary_en: A WMO bulletin cites research finding that extreme wildfire-smoke events have tripled since the 1990s and may have caused nearly 100,000 extra deaths a year from 2010 to 2018.

items.headline: 联合国教科文组织召开AI教育周
items.headline_en: UNESCO opens a global week on AI in education
items.summary: 9月8日至11日，25名以上教育部长与教师、学生、技术行业代表在巴黎讨论AI安全、年龄适宜性和采购，会议预计通过联合部长声明。
items.summary_en: More than 25 education ministers will meet teachers, students and technology representatives in Paris. Topics include AI safety, age limits and procurement. A joint statement is planned.

items.headline: 世界田联给自有赛事设可持续标准
items.headline_en: World Athletics sets a sustainability standard for its events
items.summary: 世界田联规定，2026年下半年起，所有自有赛事须达到可持续办赛标准。55项评估包括采购、废弃物、能源、食物、用水、出行和无障碍安排。
items.summary_en: From late 2026, all World Athletics-owned events must meet its sustainability standard. Its 55 action areas cover procurement, waste, energy, food, water, travel and accessibility.

previous_answers.headline:
六个人中，为什么一定能找到三位熟人，
或三位互不认识的人？
previous_answers.headline_en: Why must six people contain three mutual acquaintances or three mutual strangers?
previous_answers.explanation:
任选一人 A。其余五人中，至少有三人都认识 A，或至少有三人都不认识 A。

若 A 认识 B、C、D，其中任何两人认识，就与 A 组成三位熟人；若三人之间无人相识，B、C、D 就是三位陌生人。若 A 不认识 B、C、D，其中有两人互不认识，他们与 A 组成三位陌生人；否则 B、C、D 彼此认识。
previous_answers.explanation_en:
Choose any person A. Among the other five, at least three all know A, or at least three all do not.

If A knows B, C and D, a connected pair among them gives three mutual acquaintances with A. If there is no such pair, B, C and D are mutual strangers. If A knows none of them, an unconnected pair gives three mutual strangers with A; otherwise B, C and D all know one another.

previous_answers.headline:
单位长绳随机剪两刀，
三段能围成三角形的概率是多少？
previous_answers.headline_en: A unit string is cut at two random points. What is the probability that the three pieces form a triangle?
previous_answers.explanation:
设两刀位置为 0 < x < y < 1，三段长度为 x、y - x、1 - y。三段能成三角形，当且仅当每段都小于 1/2。

所有 (x, y) 构成面积为 1/2 的三角形。满足 x < 1/2、y > 1/2、y < x + 1/2 的区域面积为 1/8。因此概率为 (1/8) ÷ (1/2) = 1/4。
previous_answers.explanation_en:
Let the cuts be 0 < x < y < 1. The pieces have lengths x, y - x and 1 - y. They form a triangle exactly when every piece is shorter than 1/2.

All possible pairs (x, y) fill a triangle of area 1/2. The region satisfying x < 1/2, y > 1/2 and y < x + 1/2 has area 1/8. The probability is therefore (1/8) ÷ (1/2) = 1/4.
previous_answers.subject: 上周概率题

previous_answers.eyebrow: 上周思考题 · 示例估算 / LAST WEEK · SAMPLE ESTIMATE
previous_answers.headline:
北滘镇一个工作日，
大约会有多少单外卖？
previous_answers.headline_en: Roughly how many food-delivery orders are placed in Beijiao on a weekday?
previous_answers.result: 约 5 万单 / 工作日
previous_answers.explanation:
一组假设：北滘工作日常住及通勤人口约25万，其中60%会用外卖；这部分人平均每周点2单，按5个工作日均摊。

25万 × 60% × 2 ÷ 5 = 6万单。再用约1800名活跃骑手、每人每天25单核对，得到4.5万单。因此可估为约5万单，合理范围是4万到6万单。
previous_answers.explanation_en:
One set of assumptions: about 250,000 residents and commuters are in Beijiao on a weekday; 60% use food delivery and place two orders per working week. This gives 250,000 × 60% × 2 ÷ 5 = 60,000 orders.

A cross-check using 1,800 active riders at 25 orders each gives 45,000. A reasonable estimate is therefore about 50,000, with a range of 40,000 to 60,000.
